propositions: Bedrock payload and tool parity with direct Anthropic must be proven by captured outbound requests, not code inspection alone.
Both Bedrock inference-profile ids must be invokable in account 896586841071/us-east-1 before a corpus run spends budget.

The paired-run corpus must exclude agentic disposable-store specs (completion-verifier, ticket-quality, spec-alignment) and pool gold-labeled cases across eligible specs to meet the MIN_GOLD_ITEMS=20 floor.
Provider routing must be provably clean: the v2 Bedrock arm must make zero calls to non-Bedrock providers, verified from REBAR_USAGE_LOG per-call model tallies.

Temperature withdrawal from opus must be model-driven and symmetric across both providers, not a silent provider-specific behavior, confirmed by the existing supports_temperature: False capability override.
LLM model non-determinism is expected; comparing decision outcomes between different models is out of scope, but same-payload delivery and same-tool availability across providers must be proven.
